title: JoyedWarps
body:
### JoyedWarps
_Joyedwarps is a lightweight minecraft warps plugin that is simple to use_
# Dependencies
- Vault (Optional)

## Commands

```
/warp <name> - Warp to a specific warp
```
```
/warps - Lists all avalible  warps
```
```
/warpsadmin <alias> - Perform admin actions
```
## Alias
**Create**
Create a new warp
```
/warpadmin create <name>
```
**Delete**
Delete a existing warp
```
/warpadmin delete <warp>
```
**Rename**
Rename a warp
```
/warpadmin rename <warp> <newname>
```
**Lock**
Lock a warp so only admins can visit
```
/warpadmin lock <warp>
```
**Unlock**
Unlock a warp so everyone can visit
```
/warpadmin unlock <warp>
```
**Permission**
Change the permission required for a warp
```
/warpadmin permission <warp> <newpermission>
```
**Reload**
Reloads the plugin configuration
```
/warpadmin reload
```
## Permissions
**Warp**
```
joyedwarps.warp
```
**Warp List**
```
joyedwarps.warps
```
**Warps Admin**
```
joyedwarps.admin
```
